name: 🚨 Steal Anime!
desc:
🚨 Steal your favorite anime characters and build your ultimate collection! 🚨

Welcome to Steal Anime! Get ready to:

🎭 Sneak into anime worlds and steal iconic characters!
🔥 Collect powerful heroes, rivals, and legends!
💥 Battle rivals trying to take your characters back!
🏠 Store your stolen lineup and show off your anime army!
🌟 Unlock anime abilities by rebirthing!

Can you become the most feared anime thief? 🚨
If you're enjoying the game, don't forget to give it a like! 👍
